scope: Descriptive review of all 18 fixed instruction9_v1 outputs; not a calibrated quality benchmark
method: Single non-blinded assistant review of complete output text. Consecutive identical lines and blank-line runs were displayed with their counts; raw text remains unchanged in the source report.

rubric.instruction_following: met, partial, not_met, or unclear; considers the requested task and supplied constraints
rubric.task_completion: complete, incomplete, or unclear; whether the requested core content reaches a resolution, full process, or recommendation, independently of EOS and any subsequent repetitive or unrelated tail
rubric.limitations: Completion does not imply factual correctness, coherence, clean stopping, or usability. Notes record defects. No inter-rater agreement, blinded review, statistical significance, or acceptance threshold is claimed.
